question: How to handle the FA full-dev batch 2 failure (grammar refusal at batch index 101, dev file index 259) and the remaining batches?

decision.worker: a grammar refusal ('premature grammar termination refused' raised in the grammar callback, verified against the private backend diagnostics) on one query is recorded as ORIGINAL_QUERY_FALLBACK with reason GRAMMAR_REFUSED, counted and reported; the batch continues; every other exception still HOLDs and stops the batch
decision.qualification: CPU fixture with an authored refusal case before any GPU use of the repaired worker
decision.fa_b2: one continuation job for the 56 never-started queries; dev index 259 stays an original-query fallback and is NOT regenerated
decision.then: FA b3 and GR b1-b3 with the repaired worker

basis: frozen protocol section 3: any FA/GR failure (input limit, grammar refusal, unknown backend state) produces original-query fallback for that query; every query stays in the denominator
unchanged: one GPU job at a time
